title: An Embiggened Wall set to new stats stands at them, and a Buff or Nerf moves it once
notes: R3935000: an Embiggened Thorium, Surge or Plastanium Wall's bonus is three times its printed face and none once a Set stats has replaced its stat line, so a Wall set to 3/3 or 10/10 stands at exactly that and a Buff or Nerf moves it once (one taken in hand included), where each was multiplied by four (SPEC §10.4). Games recorded under v0.6.5 or earlier fold under the old script (R767000). R3935001: classify's forced games for these three Walls are steered (Harmony Spirit, Book of Stats), so the claim is backed. Phase Wall's script changes the same way but Immutable refuses a set and a Buff or Nerf, so no game plays it differently and it is not claimed.

player.title: Embiggened Walls and stat changes
fixes: An Embiggened Thorium, Surge or Plastanium Wall that is set to new stats, such as by Harmony Spirit or Dino-size, now stands at exactly those stats instead of four times them.
A Buff or a Nerf on an Embiggened Thorium, Surge or Plastanium Wall now changes its stats once instead of four times.
